styles.name: Fauvism
styles.style_features: intense non-natural colours and strong complementary contrasts; broad masses of opaque paint, simplified expressive forms, flattened space and energetic brushstrokes; colour expresses emotion instead of copying natural appearances
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as thematic inspiration, retaining only its broad subject or a few recognisable visual cues; freely omit, merge or add related elements and change their number, scale, positions and composition whenever this strengthens the style

styles.name: Cubism
styles.style_features: forms are broken apart and reconstructed through interlocking angular planes, overlapping facets and simultaneous viewpoints; shifting contours and compressed depth connect the subjects and background into one fragmented pictorial space; ochre, warm grey, muted teal and deep blue articulate the geometry
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as thematic inspiration, retaining only its broad subject or a few recognisable visual cues; freely omit, merge or add related elements and change their number, scale, positions and composition whenever this strengthens the style

styles.name: Impressionism
styles.style_features: French Impressionism exemplified by Claude Monet and Camille Pissarro: fleeting natural light, luminous atmosphere and optical colour mixing; loose, short, irregular brushstrokes and adjacent touches of colour build the forms; warm sunlit highlights, cool blue-violet shadows and soft lost-and-found edges replace hard outlines
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as thematic inspiration, retaining only its broad subject or a few recognisable visual cues; freely omit, merge or add related elements and change their number, scale, positions and composition whenever this strengthens the style

styles.name: Post-Impressionism (Van Gogh-inspired direction)
styles.style_features: one selected Van Gogh-inspired direction within the diverse Post-Impressionist movement: rhythmic directional brushstrokes, distinct dashes of opaque colour and expressive contour changes construct solid forms; saturated yellow-orange and blue-violet contrasts organise light and shadow; visible painted marks follow the movement and volume of the subject
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as thematic inspiration, retaining its broad subject or a few recognisable visual cues; freely simplify, omit, merge or add related elements and reorganise composition, scale and colour to support the selected painterly direction

styles.name: Expressionism
styles.style_features: emotional intensity shapes the entire picture through deliberately distorted contours, tense angular forms, compressed or unstable perspective and urgent, rough brushwork; dissonant non-natural colours and sharp light-dark contrasts create psychological atmosphere; expressive deformation and spatial tension are visible beyond colour changes alone
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as thematic inspiration, retaining its broad subject, relationship or a few recognisable visual cues; freely distort, simplify, merge or add related forms and reorganise scale, viewpoint and composition to express a coherent emotional atmosphere

styles.name: Surrealism
styles.style_features: dream logic transforms familiar forms through unexpected juxtaposition, metamorphosis, shifts of scale and impossible spatial relationships; convincing light and carefully rendered surfaces make the impossible relationships feel tangible; imagery grows from the source theme, with coherent visual connections rather than arbitrary unrelated fantasy objects
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as the sole visual source and thematic starting point; retain at least a few recognisable source-derived cues or relationships while freely transforming their scale, material, position and context and introducing related dreamlike connections

styles.name: Neo-Plasticism
styles.style_features: strict horizontal and vertical black lines divide an asymmetrical orthogonal composition into flat rectangular fields; pure red, yellow and blue balance white, black and occasional neutral grey; unequal spacing, line weights and colour areas create dynamic equilibrium; all forms are reduced to a flat geometric structure without diagonals, curves, gradients or modeled depth
styles.preservation_rules: abstract the reference through its broad distribution of visual weight, relative groupings, scale contrasts or directional rhythm; preserve a few traceable layout relationships while translating all figurative forms into horizontal and vertical rectangular structure; literal object recognition is optional

styles.name: Pop Art
styles.style_features: screenprinted advertising and mass-produced commercial imagery: bold flattened source-derived motifs, a small vivid spot-colour palette, hard silhouettes, slight colour-registration offsets and deliberate serial repetition; repeated image panels vary ink colours and cropping while retaining graphic recognition; printing and repetition define the treatment, with halftone dots only as an optional secondary texture
styles.preservation_rules: use the reference as the sole visual source and retain its broad theme or a few recognisable motifs; simplify, crop, repeat and recolour source-derived imagery freely to create a coherent commercial-print composition without introducing unrelated brands, readable slogans or product labels
